value.rationale: The complete all-rank, all-weight operator census is a natural invariant for higher-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebras and reveals a sharp zero-versus-nonzero weight shift. Its nonsingular branch requires genuine symplectic similitude geometry, not a substitution into the previously counted isotropic case. For dimension five over F_2, zero weight gives 65536 operators and nonzero weight 108032, a material difference. The count is exact for every finite field and all n>=2, with useful rank-by-scalar stratification, and no unsupported downstream theorem is asserted.
